source.title: Two hundred conjectures and one hundred and fifty open problems on Fermat pseudoprimes. Collected papers

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as the zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL https://zbmath.org/6260620 with trailing identifier 6260620.

Local workflow resolver rows in outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-0.csv and outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv identify the exact zbMATH record title as 'Two hundred conjectures and one hundred and fifty open problems on Fermat pseudoprimes. Collected papers' and year 2013, but provide no full-text link.

Failure modes: network_or_dns_failure for local shell fetches of api.zbmath.org, zbmath.org, vixra.org, rxiv.org, and fs.unm.edu; blocked_or_challenged or unreadable resolver output for the zbMATH web page; and metadata_only for search-result and resolver pages that did not expose a readable primary source artifact. No readable PDF or HTML full-text artifact for the exact record was recovered.

Ran exact-work recovery searches using the zbMATH identifier, the exact title, the exact title plus PDF, the exact title plus source-host terms, and viXra identifiers found from exact-title search results. Candidate pages identified viXra and fs.unm.edu PDF locations for the same apparent title, but the PDFs could not be opened or downloaded as readable artifacts through the available fetch path. Search snippets were not used as technical evidence.
